verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk editing, deleting or updating many items in one action. The Taxonomy API's create/update/delete endpoints are per-item developer building blocks that a script could loop over. Event export and cohort upload are separate data-movement features, not bulk operations on many items, so none of these earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
